author: VourMa
body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds the VBF topology to the Phase-2 HLT development menu `HLT_75e33_dev` (#52501): seven ports of the Run-3 VBF paths of `HLT_GRun`. The paths use PUPPI AK4 jets and the Phase-2 object reconstruction, and their thresholds are aligned to the offline-equivalent thresholds of the `v0p0_2026` VBF L1 seeds (including the nominal L1 Mjj cut), as a starting point for further studies.

| Phase-2 path | Run-3 path | Phase-2 L1T seeds (`v0p0_2026`) | Phase-2 HLT selection |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HLT_VBF_DiPFPuppiJet145_70_Mjj1000` | `HLT_VBF_DiPFJet125_45_Mjj1050` | `pDoubleJet_Mass_Min1000` | jets pT > 145/70, Mjj > 1000 |
| `HLT_VBF_DiPFPuppiJet118_83_Mjj600_PFPuppiMETTypeOne176` | `HLT_VBF_DiPFJet80_45_Mjj650_PFMETNoMu85` | `pDoubleJet_METSum` | jets 118/83, Mjj > 600, Type-1 PUPPI MET > 176 |
| `HLT_VBF_DiPFPuppiJet93_Mjj550_Ele24_eta2p1_WPTight_L1Seeded` | `HLT_VBF_DiPFJet50_Mjj600_Ele22_eta2p1_WPTight_Gsf` | `pDoubleJet_TkEleIso` | jets 93/93, Mjj > 550, WPTight electron ET > 24, \|eta\| < 2.1 |
| `HLT_VBF_DiPFPuppiJet133_83_Mjj700_Mu5_TrkIsoVVL` | `HLT_VBF_DiPFJet95_45_Mjj750_Mu3_TrkIsoVVL` | `pDoubleJet_TkMu` | jets 133/83, Mjj > 700, L1-matched muon pT > 5, TrkIsoVVL |
| `HLT_VBF_DiPFPuppiJet145_70_Mjj1000_Photon22_L1Seeded` | `HLT_VBF_DiPFJet50_Mjj650_Photon22` | `pDoubleJet_Mass_Min1000` | jets 145/70, Mjj > 1000, photon ET > 22, H/E |
| `HLT_VBF_DiPFPuppiJet93_Mjj600_MediumPFPuppiParTTauh61_eta2p1` | `HLT_VBF_DiPFJet45_Mjj650_PNetTauhPFJet45_L2NN_eta2p3` | `pDoubleJet_IsoTau` OR `pDoubleJet_IsoTau_Ext` | jets 93/93, Mjj > 600, 1 ParT tau jet pT > 61, \|eta\| < 2.1 |
| `HLT_VBF_DiPFPuppiJet145_70_Mjj1000_DoubleMediumPFPuppiParTTauh20_eta2p1` | `HLT_VBF_DiPFJet115_40_Mjj850_DoublePNetTauhPFJet20_eta2p3` | `pDoubleJet_Mass_Min1000` | jets 145/70, Mjj > 1000, 2 ParT tau jets pT > 20, \|eta\| < 2.1 |

In all paths the VBF pair is the largest-Mjj pair, with the Run-3 2-jet / 3-jet categories; in the lepton, photon and tau paths both VBF jets must be at dR > 0.5 from the lepton, photon or tau.

Notes:
- **L1 seeds.** The menu names the inclusive `step1_2024` seed `pDoublePuppiJet160_35_mass620` for all paths; `customizeHLTforL1P2GTv0p0_2026` gives the MET, electron, muon and single-tau paths their dedicated `v0p0_2026` seeds. For the electron and single-tau paths the L1T seed is an `HLTP2GTTripleObjectFilter`, which also saves the L1 electron or tau, as for the other cross triggers.
- **No L1-HLT jet, electron or tau matching yet.** The Run-3 matching plugins only read Stage-2 L1 objects, so the jet matching is switched off (`matchJetsByDeltaR = False`). P2GT support for these plugins is in a separate PR (#52517). The muon leg is matched to the L1 tracker muon of `pDoubleJet_TkMu`.
- **MET with muons.** The + MET path cuts on the Type-1 PUPPI MET, which includes muons like the L1 MET of `pDoubleJet_METSum` (Run-3 used MET without muons).
- **Jet-muon separation.** It is new with respect to Run-3 and makes the VBF + lepton paths consistent. It needs a new `HLTDoubletSinglet` typedef, `HLT3DoublePFJetMuon` (`HLTrigger/HLTfilters`).
- **No PUPPI jet ID** exists in the Phase-2 menu (Run-3 used PF jet ID).
- The paths are registered in `Phase2_HLT_validation_cfg.py` and in the NGT scouting trigger-object table and DQM. `Phase2_HLT_validation_cfg.py` is also fixed for the current `HLTGenValSource` (`genConfig` instead of `inputCollections`, duplicated bin edge in `ptBinsHT`).

Depends on cms-sw/cmssw#52501 (the branch is built on its head). `HLT_75e33` and `HLT_75e33_timing` are unchanged.

#### PR validation:

- `hltPhase2MenuCheck --strict`: 0 errors, 0 warnings. `check_phase2_hlt_duplicates.sh` (also on `HLT_75e33_dev`), `testPluginConfigValidationCoverage.py`, `test_hltPhase2MenuTools.sh`, code-checks and code-format pass.
- `hltPhase2MenuDump --compare` of `HLT_75e33_dev` before and after: only the 7 paths and their modules are added, with no change to existing paths or modules.
- 100-event runs with `L1P2GT:v0p0_2026,HLT:75e33_dev` on PU200 relvals (VBF H->invisible, TTbar, Z->mumu), plus L1-preselected VBF H->tautau and T1tttt events: no exceptions, and every path and cross-object filter accepts events.
- `hltPhase2UpgradeIntegrationTests --menu 75e33_dev --restrictPathsTo 'HLT_VBF_*'` on events accepted by all seven paths: no difference between each path run alone and the full menu.
- `runTheMatrix.py -w upgrade -l 38434.7504` (the `HLT_75e33_dev` workflow) passes.
- `Phase2_HLT_validation_cfg.py` and the NGT scouting unit test (`testNanohltDQM.sh`) run.
title: Add VBF paths to the Phase-2 development menu (HLT_75e33_dev)
